summary.text: Garlin Gilchrist is the Democratic nominee for Michigan Secretary of State and has been lieutenant governor since 2019. A computer engineer by training, he left the race for governor in January 2026 to run for this office, and is campaigning on protecting voter data from federal access, campaign-finance transparency and better Secretary of State branch services.

paragraphs.text: Lieutenant Governor of Michigan since 2019, serving with Gov. Gretchen Whitmer.
Previously a computer engineer; ran unsuccessfully for Detroit city clerk in 2017 against incumbent Janice Winfrey.
Entered the Secretary of State race in January 2026 after dropping out of the race for governor.
